notes.title: Mech League : Boxing is now out!!!
notes.content:
We are proud and excited to announce that v.1.0 of Mech League : Boxing is now out!!!  We have made updated to the UI of the game, and more importantly we have also balanced out the fights. 

Opponents now have lower health and damage values, and they no longer do damage when you block their attacks! We believe that these changes will allow you to play through matches a bit faster and also feel good when blocking hits. \

This build also comes with HardlightVR integration!! So if you have one of the vests try it out with the game!!! 

We look forward to your comments and feedback! And we hope that you have fun! 

LET THE BATTLES BEGIN!

notes.title: Oculus Support Update: 07/04/17
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are very excited to bring you guys Oculus support! We have mapped the controls and updated the UI for Oculus Touch Controllers. 

Along with this big update, we made a couple of minor fixes to other parts of the game: 

- Fixed bug that prevented trainer bot to get stunned once bar was full.
- When changing gloves in training room, the selected pair will also change to the color you pick.

We look forward to the feedback we get from Oculus players! And we hope that you have a lot of fun !

notes.title: Height Adjustment Update Patch : 6/08/17
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today we are releasing a new patch that contains height adjustment and also we did a bit of an adjustment to the distance between the player and the robots. 

You will be able to find the height adjustment screen under menu > options > adjust height. 

We noticed that this was something that a couple of people requested and we also felt was needed in the game.

We are busy working on new updates for the game! We look forward to new comments and feedback! :)

notes.title: Mixed Reality Update Patch : 5/31/17
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

First of all we are very greatful with the support and feedback that we have received from everyone so far! We are excited to release our first patch which includes a fix to the mixed reality bug that a few players pointed out.

SteamVR automatically goes into mixed-reality mode once you plugin a third device and include a file named externalcamera.cfg, 

The problem pointed out was that the alpha frame rendered on screen only rendered to white! The issue here was because of the post-processing options we are currently using. 

The fix we found then, was to add an option in the menu under Game Settings where you can toggle post-processing. 

If you want to enable mixed-reality through steam-vr first you need to go into game settings, disable post-processing and reboot the game. 

We are excited to see any mixed reality videos that you guys make! :D Please keep us posted! 

The patch also includes a fix to the training match: 
- Training Bot will no longer react to hits during 'counter' tutorial: We found that it might have been a bit confusing for some, and we got reports of people getting stuck at this point. 

We will keep working hard to bring you guys new updates and fixes to bug reports!
